description: CesiumJS is an open-source JavaScript library for 3D globes and maps on the web, and Cesium ion is Cesium's software-as-a-service platform that tiles, hosts and streams 3D geospatial content. CesiumJS streams 3D Tiles for buildings, photogrammetry and point clouds, shows glTF models, terrain and imagery, loads KML, GeoJSON and CZML, supports time-dynamic 4D visualisation and switches between 3D, 2D and Columbus view on a high-precision WGS84 globe; it has been open source since 2012 under Apache 2.0, free for commercial and non-commercial use. Cesium ion converts uploaded point clouds, photogrammetry, 3D models, buildings, imagery and terrain into 3D Tiles, hosts them in the cloud and combines them with curated global content: Cesium World Terrain, Bing Maps and Google Maps imagery and Cesium OSM Buildings. The Cesium ion SDK adds GPU-accelerated analysis tools. Coverage: global curated content plus the user's own data. Access: npm install or download for CesiumJS; Cesium ion offers a free trial, with commercial plans whose prices were not read. Licence: Apache 2.0 for CesiumJS, commercial for ion. Caveats: curated layers carry their own terms, and ion pricing was not read. Simulation uses: web viewers for city digital twins, building exposure maps and time-dynamic simulation results. Related records: OpenStreetMap, the OSM Buildings viewer, Bentley iTwin and the 3D City Database.
